scientific_integrity: The infinite-volume law and strict covariance sign follow analytically from a Volterra shielding recursion and strict convexity. Finite-volume rational enumeration is diagnostic, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform one-attempt two-colour nearest-neighbour blocking on the integer line at time 0<t<=1 and 0<alpha<1. Only second-neighbor correlation is classified; no full association property or general-distance sign is claimed. Earlier unindexed pair-correlation literature may remain.
title: Exact second-neighbor correlation in one-shot antagonistic adsorption
